source_of_truth: tasks/document/rvl_cdip_eval.py (CLASS_TO_FAMILY); this file is the declarative copy and is verified against it by verify_config_file()
rejection_criterion: Rejection targets are not classifier families: the only correct outcome is abstained or fallback.
subtype_note: Taxonomy 2.1 adds subtypes within a family. No label was remapped: news_article remains the public key and the RVL-CDIP class it maps from, and the subtype distinguishes a whole newspaper issue from a single clipped article.

decisions.note: RVL-CDIP 'scientific report' mixes institutional/laboratory reports with preprint-shaped documents. Changing this changes ground truth; metrics computed under different selections must not be pooled.
RVL-CDIP has no press-release class. Under 'not_news_article' press-release markers block the news_article gate; under 'news_article' they do not.
